text:
Maria G: Kicking off the region-by-region rollout for service = inference-api v3.2.1. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. Will run 10% canary in US for 15m, then ramp to 50% if no alerts. Need capacity thumbs and pin for EU fallback (v3.1.9-quant) in case of saturation. Release notes: https://wiki.redwood/runtime/v3-2-1
Tom W: Noted. US canary at 02:10 UTC for 15m? I'll watch the pod and GPU queues.
deploy-bot: [INFO] 02:10:15 UTC starting canary deploy slice=us tag=v3.2.1 canary=10%
Jen K: ops-oncall, please confirm warm-pool is at 80% capacity in us-east prior to canary. Also ensure prefix cache warmup set to 10m.
ops-oncall: Warm pool at 82% in us-east, cache-warmup job scheduled +10m. Will post heatmap if anything spikes.
Kevin R: Quick perf note: v3.2.1 increases KV-cache memory by ~4% on longer context. Tracker: watch host mem and eviction rates.
Sophie P: Confirmed release notes include the model fallback matrix and quantized variant for EU. Also added rollback runbook link.
Maria G: If latency p95 > 350ms for >5m we abort ramp and pin traffic back to v3.1.9. Rollback criteria listed in runbook.
Tom W: I'll set alerts: p95 latency, GPU util, queue_length, and routing_error_rate. Thresholds: p95 latency 350ms, GPU util 85%, queue_len > 50.
deploy-bot: [WARN] 02:22:40 UTC us-canary: p95 latency 290ms, queue_len 12, gpu_util 62%
Jen K: All green so far. Proceeding to ramp to 50% at +15m if metrics hold.
deploy-bot: [INFO] 02:25:15 UTC ramping canary -> 50% slice=us
ops-oncall: US metrics after ramp: p95 310ms, gpu_util 74%, minor spike in evictions but within tolerance. No errors.
Kevin R: For EU, pre-provisioning 12 extra vram-heavy nodes. Suggest pin fallback image v3.1.9-quant in region in case we hit memory pressure.
Maria G: Please pin that and keep it ready. Also if EU thermal throttling is detected during rollout, fall back to pin immediately and don't escalate to APAC yet.
Sophie P: APAC scheduled only after EU stable for 30m. We'll keep a 45m buffer.
deploy-bot: [INFO] 02:45:00 UTC us rollout -> stable at 50%. No rollback triggered. Next window: EU canary @03:00 UTC 10%.
Tom W: Will be on watch. tagging @ops-oncall for EU thermal sensors.
ops-oncall: EU warm pool 70% currently, starting pre-warm to 90% now. ETA 12m.
Maria G: Reminder: change window ends 06:00 UTC. If APAC can't be done before window close, we hold APAC and schedule a follow-up window.
deploy-bot: [INFO] 03:05:10 UTC eu-canary started slice=eu tag=v3.2.1 canary=10%
deploy-bot: [WARN] 03:12:34 UTC eu-canary: gpu_util 88% on node group eu-3, p95 latency 380ms (above threshold)
Tom W: Seeing the same in dashboard. Raising rollback flag.
Maria G: Rollback trigger met for EU. Execute EU fallback pin to v3.1.9-quant, drain traffic from v3.2.1 in region. No APAC.
deploy-bot: [ACTION] 03:13:01 UTC starting immediate pin fallback region=eu target=v3.1.9-quant reason="gpu_util > 85% & p95 > 350ms"
ops-oncall: Draining v3.2.1 in EU, routing shift in progress. ETA 2m.
deploy-bot: [INFO] 03:15:20 UTC eu rollback complete, traffic pinned to v3.1.9-quant.
Kevin R: Post-mortem action: investigate memory growth in v3.2.1 for european models under dataset X. Also add a slow-roll patch to reduce KV prefetch.
Jen K: Noted. I'll open a follow-up PR and link to this thread.
Maria G: Good call. We'll re-run EU canary with a patched memory cap once the fix is validated in staging. APAC deferred.
Sophie P: Adding note to release notes: EU fallback happened automated, no user impact. Documented steps and revert reasoning.
Tom W: Thanks team. Will keep monitoring until the end of change window. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: [INFO] 03:25:00 UTC thread closed by Maria G
